requirement.statement: Every new session needs a unique identifier that is safe to put in a cookie.

criteria.statement: Each call returns a distinct RFC 4122 version 4 identifier.
No package is added that is not already installed.

proposed.summary: Write an id module with a counter, a process fingerprint and a base32 encoder.

candidates.summary: node:crypto.randomUUID already returns an RFC 4122 version 4 identifier.
The uuid package is already a dependency of this application.
